title: Very informative and knowledgeable, Miguel was a great guide.
text: Miguel was interesting, funny and encouraged us all to get involved.  He also gave us all a few bits of local knowledge to help us during the rest of our stay.   The tour lasted over two hours and finished at the picturesque Plaza España - we were recommended a place nearby to go afterwards for food and a drink,  which we needed.  It was very pleasant.  It is so much better to have a guide explain things you might never know about otherwise.  Some of the history is not easy to hear but it's important to know these things.
author: R5JM

title: Awesome walk with Miguel
text: Great guide! Miguel is very professional, fun and knows his Seville and Spanish history!

title: A fun and informative tour.

author: janicefT6556ZT

title: Miguel Rocks! fab Seville walking tour
text: We went on Miguel’s walking tour. Easy to find him at the start. His tour in english was professional and his chat was entertaining throughout, we learnt a thing or two and he made interactive as well. It was good to have earpieces so we could always hear what he was saying Thoroughly enjoyed and agreed would never have found half of the places he took us wandering around on our own. Thanks Miguel, best thing we did in Seville.
author: rosieb681

title: Excellent experience
text:
We had an excellent tour with Miguel. He has fantastic local knowledge, but is also really entertaining with a great sense of humour.
After booking, he also sends a welcome message by WhatsApp. We were running late for the meet-up because our train to Seville was delayed, but Miguel shared his live location so that we were able to catch up with the tour.
There were so many interesting things on this tour, that you would walk past or not know about, if you were visiting by yourself. Definitely the best walking tour I've been on.
Muchas gracias Miguel!!
